objectives.text: Speak with Magatha in Thunder Bluff.

accept.text: The tauren have a bond with the land, and it pains me to hear of Stonetalon's plight.  But I fear that to heal the land, we must first remove the disease upon it.$B$BIs it not fortunate, then, that the Forsaken are allied with us?  They know much of disease.  I believe they can aid us, and by doing so they will strengthen the trust between our people.$B$BSpeak with Apothecary Zamah.  She is a scholar and an emissary of the Forsaken.  You will find her in the Pools of Vision below the Spirit Rise.

complete.text:
Magatha sent word of your coming, $N.  Although my heart beats no longer, I still feel sorrow for the spirits of Stonetalon.

The Forsaken are eager to offer what help we can.

objectives.text: Speak with Apothecary Zamah in the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff.

accept.text: To rid Stonetalon of the Venture Company, we must take extreme measures.  Extreme, but without bloodshed.$B$BA colleague of mine may have just the tool we need.  His name is Lydon; he dwells in the town of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills, in the distant land of Lordaeron.$B$BTo reach Hillsbrad, travel by zeppelin to our capital, the Undercity.  Then go north to Tirisfal Glades, southwest to Silverpine, and south to Hillsbrad.$B$BSeek Lydon and bring him this note.  It details our needs to him.

objectives.text: Bring Zamah's Note to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

accept.text: There is a relation to the spiritual magic of shamans and the natural magic of druids.  This is why we shamans can hear the plea of the spirits of Stonetalon.  Many of their whisperings are lost to me, but one message, one vision, is clear...$B$BI saw a vision of two man-shaped machines in Windshear Crag, northwest of Greatwood Vale, felling trees with impossible speed.  These metal beasts must be stopped!$B$BIn my vision, the machines were marked with strange symbols:$B$BXT:4 and XT:9.

objectives.text: Kill the shredders XT:4 and XT:9, then return to Seereth Stonebreak at the border of the Stonetalon Mountains and the Barrens.

progress.text: The tree spirits wail at the loss of their brethren, $N.  You must destroy the shredders XT:4 and XT:9, or I fear Stonetalon will never be healed.

complete.text:
You got them!  Thank you!

I'll have these sent to Dizzywig and get them shipped to Booty Bay.  I can already taste the profits!

Here is your cut, $N.  I couldn't have made this deal without you.

progress.text: Did you get the eggs, $N?  I already made a shipping deal with Wharfmaster Dizzywig!

complete.text:
Already I can feel it... yes... power so sweet... the rushing flood. The kaldorei are foolish to spurn the gifts of this world, to reject the coursing of magic as it flows singing through your veins.

What a pale mockery life is without its burning embrace!

accept.text: Terrible what the Venture Company has done here, eh? What were they thinking? Goblin company hiring a gnome!$b$bLucky for me, Sputtervalve knows a genius when he sees one. Hired me just after I'd been kicked out!$b$bTells me they built some enormous woodcutting machine, and Sput' wants me to steal the plans for him. Unfortunately, Gerenzo--bloody gnome--wants me dead on sight... maybe you could steal the plans for me? You should be able to find them on one of their operators.

complete.text:
Hey, is that what I think it is? Great!

Now, let's see. Ugh... how am I supposed to understand this stuff... can't figure out the way gnomes think. Lemme tell you, I'm surprised they could build the wheel, let alone those flying machines they like so much.

objectives.text: Get the Super Reaper 6000 Blueprints for Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains.

progress.text: Did you find those plans? I'm eager to impress the new boss. Hopefully, once he's convinced of my loyalty--well, as much as he can be convinced... goblin's honor, you know?--he'll feel comfortable making use of my rather impressive genius.

accept.text: This envelope has all the information I was able to snatch as they booted me out the door... Venture Company internal documents, some manuals, technical things... Oh, and of course the Super Reaper 6000 blueprints.$b$bSputtervalve has taken up residence at Ratchet in the Barrens. Shouldn't have much trouble finding him, he's a little green fellow.

objectives.text: Deliver the Sealed Envelope to Sputtervalve in the Barrens.

complete.text:
So, $N, you have come.  Now, are you prepared to journey through distant lands?

If so, young $c, then listen on...

accept.text: At times we hunt for food.  At times we hunt for honor.  And at times we hunt to earn the Earthmother's teachings.$B$BBut the hunt I now set upon you is none of these things.  It is to slay a creature outside the Earthmother's blessing.$B$BThe hyena Steelsnap roams the Thousand Needles, south of the Barrens.  He is a tyrant, attracting other hyenas to him and spreading fear and bloodshed among more peaceful beasts.$B$BFind Steelsnap, $n.  Find him, and defeat him.

objectives.text: Bring Steelsnap's Rib to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

accept.text: At last, help has arrived!$b$bYou have no clue how long I've been held prisoner here. I can't remember the last time I saw the outside of this place.$b$bYou see, I am an entrepreneur. Always out for a copper, as they say. I caught wind that Mebok Mizzyrix was paying well for Redleaf Tuber from this here pig pen. I figured it would be an easy in, easy out kind of affair. As you can see, I was a bit wrong!$b$bAnyway, if you'd be so kind as to help me get out of here, I'll make it worth your while.

complete.text: Thanks again, friend! I told you I'd make it worth your while.

objectives.text: Escort Willix the Importer out of Razorfen Kraul.

accept.text: The harlot! The swine! Kenata still lives; her family healthy and prospering while I suffer. Forsaken indeed!$B$BMy family is gone, taken by the plague. Our estate also forfeit; looted and burned during the war. And after all that, her and her lousy children had the audacity to steal the only precious belongings I had left.$B$BI don't care about the things they stole any more. What I want now are their heads!$B$BKill them for me! Go to the Dabyrie Farmstead in Arathi, northeast of Refuge Point.

objectives.text: Bring Kenata, Fardel, and Marcel Dabyrie's Heads to Genavie Callow in Undercity.

accept.text: The Galak centaur in the Thousand Needles are protecting an artifact from the time of the centaurs' creation.$b$bWe would like to retrieve it, but we require a phial of water from one of the night elves' moonwells.$b$bTo collect the water, you will first need to obtain one of the phials carried by the dryads near the Raynewood Retreat in the heart of Ashenvale Forest. There is a moonwell near the western bank of the Falfarren River, south of the main road, where you can fill the phial.

objectives.text: Return a Filled Etched Phial to Zangen Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

accept.text: A colleague in Kalimdor, Apothecary Helbrim, is researching the effects of Lordaeron toxins on the beasts of Kalimdor.  He would be very interested in a sample of the wolf hearts Renferrel sent me.$B$BHelbrim is stationed in the Barrens, in a village known as the Crossroads.  To reach him, you must travel via zeppelin to the orc capital of Orgrimmar, then travel south, by foot, to Durotar.  Head west into the Barrens, and you will soon reach the Crossroads.

complete.text:
Ah, very good.  If initial reports are true, then the toxicity of these hearts could lead to further advances in our knowledge of poisons.

This is a welcome delivery, $N.  Your reward is well earned.

objectives.text: Bring the Wolf Heart Sample to Apothecary Helbrim in the Barrens.

progress.text: You have a package for me?

accept.text: The wolf hearts you acquired possess a quality unseen in similar specimens.  There is a toxicity to them that should be deadly to the very wolves in which the hearts beat!$B$BIt's quite incredible, and we must study it further.  I kept a few samples of the hearts acquired.  Take them to my colleague, Apothecary Zinge.  You will find her in our headquarters in the Undercity.

complete.text: Ah yes, the heart samples of which Renferrel spoke.  I am eager to experiment with these... it is always of interest to the Royal Apothecary Society when new forms of toxins are discovered.

objectives.text: Bring the Wolf Heart Samples to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.

progress.text: You have something for me?

accept.text: The shells you brought me have a taint, one I have never before seen.  I am certain the water of the Oases is the cause, and I can sense the confusion they cause this land.  It is as if the land dreams and cannot awake.$B$BThe Wailing Caverns must be the source of the taint.  But before you go there, speak with Hamuul Runetotem, the elder druid.  I sent word to him of the happenings in the Barrens.  He is wise, and can offer you counsel.$B$BYou will find him in Thunder Bluff, on the Elder Rise.

complete.text: I bid you greetings, $N.  You are welcome here, and I suggest you gather all your strength.  For the task we now set before you ... is a dire one.

objectives.text: Speak with Hamuul Runetotem

accept.text: I entered the land of dreams, and dreamed of a cult of druids who dwell in the Wailing Caverns.  I saw that their goals were once noble, but they have lost their way.  They are now servants of the taint seeping through the Barrens.$B$BI am old and my strength fails.  I could not long dwell in that dreaming place and know little more of the tainted druids.  But Nara is young and her spirit is fierce.  She remained in the dreaming when I fled.$B$BSpeak with Nara.  She is in the tent, over yonder.

complete.text:
Yes, it is true.  I know of the druids in the Wailing Caverns.  I have seen their twisted, scaled faces.  I know their crimes, and I know their plans.

You must stop them, $N.

objectives.text: Speak with Nara Wildmane.

complete.text:
Great, you got it!  I can't wait to try it out.  This is going to make me a fortune, I just know it!

Thank you, $N.  Take this, and after I'm rich I'll send you more, I promise!

progress.text: Where is my wailing essence?

accept.text: The fabled city of Xavian lies nestled deep within eastern Ashenvale, and tales of its ancient knowledge are well known among the learned.  It is said that the waters of Xavian hold vast magical powers.$B$BI would have a sample of those waters, from their source.$B$BTake this flask and go to Xavian.  Gather water from the bottom of its highest waterfall, and return to me.  And use care as you move through that ancient city--satyrs now hold the ruins and do not like mages prying into their affairs.

objectives.text: Bring the Xavian Water Sample to Deino in Orgrimmar.

accept.text: Gnome technology - two years ago its most common use was as a punch line. Times certainly have changed. Now they've got a new rig built that's better than all our shredder models combined. I need the blueprints, $n!$B$BUnfortunately, the plans are locked away in a safe near Mekgineer Thermaplugg. To make matters worse, the combination to the safe is only known by Mekgineer Thermaplugg.$B$BDo whatever you have to do to get that combination, $n. Then crack open that safe and bring back those blueprints!

objectives.text: Retrieve the Rig Blueprints and Thermaplugg's Safe Combination from Gnomeregan and bring them to Nogg in Orgrimmar.

accept.text: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, $n.$B$BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the rogue trainer Rwag. He would have words with you when you're ready.

complete.text: Now that you know where I'm holding up, I should let you know: the Shattered Hand's asked me to look out for you. They want me to train you and keep you informed of anything they might need. Even if you're not interested in helping them yet--which you'd be a fool not to be--I'll do what I can to train you... for a small fee. Come back to me anytime you think you're ready, and we'll see what you're ready to learn.

objectives.text: Read the Encrypted Parchment and speak to Rwag in the Valley of Trials.

progress.text:
Shhh, not so loud. I don't trust Nartok over there. Anyone that has to hide deeper in a cave than I do shouldn't be trifled with.

I trust you had no problem finding your way around?

accept.text: While you were out helping our deathstalkers, Apothecary Renferrel sent you a summons.  He did not give me details, but he wanted to speak with you about the wolf hearts you had given him.

complete.text: Ah, very good.  There is a matter regarding the wolf hearts you brought to me earlier that demands our attention.

objectives.text: Speak with Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

accept.text: Your time with me is over, $n.  To learn more, you must go to Camp Taurajo to the south and speak with Jorn Skyseer.  He will continue your guidance.

complete.text:
Greetings, young one.  You are here to walk the hunter's path?

Very good.  Let us begin.

objectives.text: Speak with Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.

accept.text: You may have killed the raptors, but the silver they stole must be recovered!  I have reports that the raptors have a large grouping of nests south of Ratchet, known as the Raptor Grounds.  It is likely that they brought our stolen silver there.$B$BGo to this raptor haven and search for the stolen silver.  When you find it, return it to me.

complete.text:
Aha!  So the raptors did hide the silver at their lair.  It's hard to believe these beasts would have the desire for silver.  Perhaps the stories of their intelligence are not as far from the mark as I thought!

Thank you, $N.  Take this as a reward for your service to us, and know that the guards of the crossroads owe their next month's pay to you.

objectives.text: Bring the Stolen Silver to Gazrog in the Crossroads.

progress.text: Do you have the silver?

accept.text: My clanmate, Mura Runetotem, traveled to Silverpine so that she might aid our undead allies.  Silverpine is an ailing forest, a dying forest, and it was Mura's hope to bring it new life.  Perhaps the strange life found here in the Barrens can help her work in Silverpine.$B$BTake a sample of the shells you gathered, and bring it to Mura in Silverpine.  She is staying at the Sepulcher.  With luck, studying the shell will give her the insight she needs to heal that dying place.

complete.text:
Ah, what is this?  This shell has an inner glow, as if it still pulses with life.  Amazing!  I must study it further.

Thank you, $N.  With luck, this shell will hold a secret I can use to aid the poor land of Silverpine.

objectives.text: Speak with Mura Runetotem in the Sepulcher.

progress.text: I can smell the dust of the Barrens on you, $c.  You have traveled far.

accept.text: I think I might have broken that Samophlange.  That's not good, because I already told some colleagues in Undermine about it and they were very intrigued.  We must find a way to fix it!$B$BTake the broken samophlange to Wenikee Boltbucket, just south of Mor'shan Rampart, the horde outpost between the Barrens and Ashenvale.  She is very clever and inquisitive.  If you show her the samophlange I bet she'd jump at the chance to fix it.

complete.text:
Oh, what's this?  A samophlange, you say?  What's a samophlange??

Ah... but look at the way it moves when you handle it.  And there's the sound of intricate gears inside.  Oh my!  I want to fix it and see what it does, don't you??

objectives.text: Bring the Broken Samophlange to Wenikee Boltbucket.

progress.text: I'm very busy with my work, $c.  Unless you have something for me, it'd be best if you moved along...

accept.text: I want to fix this samophlange, but to do that I'm going to need some supplies.  I ran out of seventeen-point-five gauge nugget slugs and I'm going to need a bunch of those for the work ahead.$B$BThe closest place to get them is the Sludge Fen to the east.  The Venture Company usually keeps them in their tool buckets.  Go to the Sludge Fen and look in the tool buckets you find there, then return to me when you've gathered enough nugget slugs.

complete.text: Great, you got them!  Now I can get to work...

objectives.text: Bring 15 Nugget Slugs to Wenikee Boltbucket in the Barrens.

progress.text: Do you have the nugget slugs, $N?  I've been eyeing this Samophlange and I can't wait to tinker with it.

accept.text: Well, that didn't work.  I put some extra gauges on the samophlange to measure its structural integrity, and they read the integrity at an all-time low.  I could add some more dials and maybe a lever or two to try and fix it, but... I think that might make things even worse.$B$BYou should take the samophlange to Rilli Greasygob.  He used to work for the Venture Company -- if anyone knows how to fix it, it's Rilli.$B$BYou can find him at Nogg's Machine Shop in Orgrimmar, in the Valley of Honor.

complete.text:
What's this?  Why, it's a samophlange!  Where did you get this thing?  Have you been poking around the Venture Company holdings in the Barrens?

You must be very brave, or very stupid.

objectives.text: Bring the Broken and Battered Samophlange to Rilli Greasygob in Orgrimmar.

progress.text: Mind your head!  I don't want it to get in the way of my work!

accept.text: I think I can fix the samophlange, but I'm going to need the user's manual first.  When I was in the Venture Company I had a rival, Boss Copperplug, who hoarded the secrets of the samophlange, giving out small bits of knowledge on the device to those he trusted.  I wasn't one of the trusted few...$B$BBoss Copperplug used to stay at the Boulder Lode Mine in northeastern Barrens.  Get the manual from him, and if he's given pages from it to anyone, you'll have to collect them too.

complete.text:
You got the manual!  I can't wait to read it and find out how to fix the Samophlange!  I spoke with Sputtervalve in Ratchet--he wanted to thank you for your help, and wanted to reward your efforts.

I want to thank you too, and if I ever get this thing fixed I'll let you know...

objectives.text: Bring the Samophlange Manual to Rilli Greasygob in Orgrimmar.

progress.text: Do you have the manual?

accept.text: It sure gets hot out here in the Valley of Trials.$B$B<Galgar wipes his brow.>$B$BIf only I had some cactus apples, I could make my famous cactus apple surprise! Nothing cools you off faster than a piece of that delicious treat.$B$BI'll tell you what, $n. If you bring me 10 cactus apples, I'll make you a few portions of cactus apple surprise to take with you on your adventures, and a free training manual, too. If you're interested, you can find cactus apples growing near the cactus plants around here.

complete.text: Wonderful, $N! As promised, here is your cactus apple surprise. Pick one of these training manuals, too. I've got plenty to go around.

objectives.text: Bring Galgar 10 Cactus Apples. You remember him saying that they could be found near cactuses.

progress.text: Have you finished collecting cactus apples?

accept.text: Finally, you are of age, $n... of age to battle in the name of the Horde. To conquer for the glory of the Warchief.$B$BYes...$B$B<Kaltunk looks you over.>$B$BYou will do nicely.$B$BNo doubt you wish to find a great dragon or demon and strangle it with your bare hands, but perhaps it would be wise to start on something less... dangerous.$B$B<Kaltunk laughs.>$B$BReport to Gornek, he should be able to assign a task better suited to a young $c. You will find Gornek in the Den, to the west.

complete.text:
Another one of Kaltunk's recruits, hm?

A sorry state of affairs we find ourselves in if this is the best the Horde can produce. No matter. By the time we think you're ready to leave the Valley, you'll be a proud warrior of the Horde.

objectives.text: Speak with Gornek. You recall Kaltunk marking your map with his location and mentioning that Gornek resided in the Den, a building to the west.

complete.text: Haha! Thank you, $N! This will help us greatly. You're a boon to the Crossroads and to the Horde. If there is anything I can do for you, please, let me know.

progress.text: How goes your search for the supplies, $N? I trust the quilboar fall under your strength easily.

I'll reward anyone who makes my life a bit easier... I enjoy doing as little as possible, mon!

Below the docks here in Shadowprey Village, I've many shellfish traps.  If you're kind enough to do my work and collect me my shellfish, then I'll reward you with something you want... get my drift mon?  For every five shellfish you bring me I will give you a fine Bloodbelly fish!

accept.text: The troggs are not the only thing that interested Magatha in Ragefire Chasm. She has heard word that one of her servants, a Maur Grimtotem, found something peculiar while in the Chasm, but he never made it out to show her what. She'd like Maur's body found--if it still exists--and any signs of what he found while attempting to speak to the troggs.$B$BReturn to Magatha any items of interest, and I'm sure she would be very generous in her reward.$B$BAgain, seek the Chasm in the darkest areas of Orgrimmar.

complete.text:
The body looks seriously beaten by clubs or fists, but most of the corpse's clothing and equipment still looks present. It seems the troggs do not overly care much for material wealth.

You begin to search the body for anything of interest that might help Magatha.

objectives.text: Search Ragefire Chasm for Maur Grimtotem's corpse and search it for any items of interest.

progress.text:
How goes your search for the Chasm? And the troggs?

The threat cannot be allowed to persist--it will only injure our $r brethren if it continues.

accept.text: You find a satchel under the body of the tauren. It is still gripped tightly in his arms as though he was trying to protect it while being attacked by the troggs.$B$BRemoving the satchel from his vice-like grip, you stow it with your own equipment and prepare to make your way out of the tunnels and back to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.

objectives.text: Take the Grimtotem Satchel to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.

accept.text: The primary task set upon me by our great Warchief is to root out the creatures responsible for infesting our lord's great city with demonic influence. The Burning Blade is one threat, but there are others; the Searing Blade for instance, who make their home in Ragefire Chasm, secretly attempting to subvert innocent members of the Horde.$B$BIf they are to be stopped, then their leader must be slain--a Felguard named Taragaman the Hungerer.$B$BKill him, and his heart will appease Thrall, of this I'm sure.

objectives.text: Enter Ragefire Chasm and slay Taragaman the Hungerer, then bring his heart back to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

accept.text: Long ago, a dwarf came to this land.  His name was Hemet and he wished to hunt great beasts.  His skills with the rifle were uncanny, and we spent many days hunting together.  Even the enmity between our peoples was forgotten.$B$BWhen he left Desolace for Stranglethorn, I vowed to one day welcome him back so that we may hunt again.  Now is that time.$B$BTake this kodo horn to Hemet.  He will know it is from me.  You will find him in Stranglethorn, north of the Grom'gol Base camp.

objectives.text: Bring Roon's Kodo Horn to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn.

accept.text: The Horde does well keeping our troops fresh... since the Great War we have been prosperous here in Kalimdor.$B$BI need you to do me a favor, I have a lad by the name of Grish Longrunner protecting the Great Lift in the southern barrens. Give him this letter; the letter will let him know that I have a reserve warrior coming to relieve him of duty so that he can visit his family. He requested this sometime ago and he would be happy to hear the news.

objectives.text: Maggran wishes you to deliver a letter to Grish Longrunner at the Great Lift in the Barrens.

complete.text: This is most excellent news! Tell me again how you cast fear into the cold hearts of those vile harpies. The Bloodfuries have been dealt a serious blow!

Already I feel the anger leave me. What will I do with my time? Knowing evil moves near my land kept my thoughts moving, though now they are silent. Perhaps this is a good thing... maybe now I can focus on the good, as all Tauren should.

Please accept this as a reward for your troubles.

progress.text:
Bloodfury Ripper is a nasty creature! You will have success finding her along the western hill line in the Charred Vale.

The bloodfuries will be helpless with out... surely we can vanquish them forever!

complete.text:
Good hunting, $N! Besseleth is an old predator in these parts... I will miss her not. Take this reward as a token for being the forest champion.

<Maggran rubs the wound caused by Besseleth.>

Perhaps now many more will travel to Sun Rock Retreat without fearing what lurks in the dark.

progress.text: Besseleth is a ruthless predator... I fear for those that travel Webwinder Path at night. It's then that she and her children prey upon innocent travelers. I myself fell prey to her two-foot fang of death, but luckily I was able to fend her off and get to safety. I would give anything to see that monster destroyed.

complete.text:
Ah, $N, you have the Gaea seeds. Watch and see how the blessing of the Earthmother can cause even these small kernels of life to bloom and flourish.

<Tammra begins to chant.>

progress.text: The continuous destruction caused by war and those that seek a profit from lumber pains me deeply. To aid the cycle of rebirth and replenish the lands, I need Gaea seeds. Do you have them, $c?

complete.text:
This is great victory for the land. In time, other things will come to pass: the Venture Co. will pack up their buzz saws and axes, the angry fire spirits will calm, and the harpies will be pushed out by the land.

Only then $N, will Stonetalon be truly at peace.

You have done well $c; take one of these items as thanks for the new life you have created here today.

progress.text:
These seeds you plant are strong, resisting corruption, and making a foothold for other life. They will grow and grow, first preventing corruption and healing the scarred land, and then one day, restoring Stonetalon to a lush forest, once again.

Have you planted all of the Gaea seeds?

complete.text:
Welcome to the new frontier, $N.  Ashenvale is a land of opportunity, one where a young $c like yourself is able to find boundless chances to prove their mettle.  Look around the outpost here, and be sure to travel out to the Zoram Strand, as the Horde has another outpost there as well.

Your presence here tells me that you've come to learn more about the hunt.  Listen close, and I will gladly share with you what you need to know.

There are three legendary creatures that make up the Ashenvale Hunt; you may seek them and test yourself against their cunning and might.  In the process, you will hopefully learn something about yourself.  The creatures are: the bear Ursangous, the nightsaber cat Shadumbra, and the hippogryph Sharptalon.

The creatures of the Ashenvale Hunt are powerful, and you may find that you'll need aid in bringing them down.  If you should best them, bring me proof of your deed.

progress.text: The Tribunal of the Tides grows impatient. They seek to end this war that has raged across all dimensions for eons. My brethren are anxious to hear news of the glorious victory over the hated fire elementals. Have you the Incendrites that I require?

accept.text: Tell Tammra Windfield, Kaya's aunt who's at Sun Rock Retreat, about the good news! Kaya is alive! We had thought she was lost after the brutal attack on our village. Follow the path to the west to get to Sun Rock Retreat.

complete.text: My goodness, my niece Kaya is alive! That is good news indeed. Thank you, $N.

objectives.text: Tell Tammra Windfield in Sun Rock Retreat the good news.

complete.text:
Ah... Yes! That's it; the Resonite crystals have a trace of Earthen magic. The kobolds must have dug deep uncovering an Earthen.

Legend states that the Earthen are creatures created by the Titans.  They were used to create the land our feet walk on. This most definitely is a threat that cannot be ignored.

<Mor'rogal shakes his head.>

Perhaps I can enchant these ore samples to use against this kobold plot.

progress.text: What news have you discovered from Boulderslide Ravine? I recall some legend that deals with Resonite... I just cannot place my hoof on it. Perhaps knowing what lies at the bottom of the cave will illuminate their devious intentions.

accept.text: Heya! I've been traveling through Ashenvale, heading towards Ratchet, and decided to make a stop here at Splintertree. I'm always looking for an opportunity, and it seems that satyr horns are in high demand in Ratchet these days.$B$BAfter asking around here, it seems that the satyrs in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian all have the type of horns I am looking for. I'm no match for those satyrs... but you look like you might be!$B$BTell you what, you collect the horns for me and I'll make it worth your time.

objectives.text: Collect 16 Satyr Horns for Pixel in Splintertree Post.

accept.text:
There is evil lurking here along the coast, skyborne.

It is the resting place of the doomed city of Zoram, long destroyed and submerged beneath the seas.  Lost, and nearly forgotten.

Now, the naga have returned, and for what reason we do not know.  But reason matters little; we must defend the land we have worked so hard to claim as our own.

Return to me with 20 of their heads! Throw the naga back to the depths!

objectives.text: Bring 20 Wrathtail Heads to Marukai along the Zoram Strand.

accept.text: My kinfolk were traveling here with many sacred troll charms, but the Thistlefur furbolgs attacked and killed them before they reached Zoram'gar!  Those vile Furbolgs!$B$BI miss my brothers and sisters who were killed, but we will meet again in the afterlife.  However, their troll charms hold great value in this world.  It is an outrage that the furbolgs have them!$B$B$n, you must retrieve the charms!  They are in chests in Thistlefur Hold, a cave at the end of Thistlefur Village, north of Astranaar.

objectives.text: Bring 8 Troll Charms to Mitsuwa at the Zoram'gar Outpost.

accept.text: You have uncovered a dark threat to the land, $c. The Resonite cask you have found in that cave houses a slumbering Earthen by the name of Goggeroc.$B$BI have changed the mixture of the Resonite crystals that you gathered with my shamanistic powers. Take the enchanted Resonite crystal and smash open the Resonite cask, which houses the Earthen.$B$BWhen awakened, Goggeroc will be weakened... Slay him, $n!

complete.text:
You bear good news, $c! I fear the possibilities of what an Earthen would mean to Kalimdor.

Slaying Goggeroc was a task for no one less than a hero. You have done well; all of Stonetalon and Kalimdor are indebted to you, noble $c.

Accept this as your reward most honored one.

objectives.text: Open the Resonite cask with the Enchanted Resonite Crystal, and then slay Goggeroc. Return to Mor'rogal with the news and Enchanted Resonite Crystal.

accept.text: Eh?  Who are you?$B$B$n?  You're no furbolg.  They are cursed!  They thought I was a bear and captured me, and now they starve me!  My strength is failing...$B$BHelp me escape, then speak with my sister Yama at the Splintertree Post to the east.$B$B$n! I must escape!

objectives.text: Escort Ruul, then speak with Yama Snowhoof in Spintertree Post.

accept.text: We received reports that Ashenvale outrunners left Silverwing Outpost not long ago, and now sneak near our territories in the forest.  We don't want them gathering intelligence on our defenses!$B$BSneak through the forests south of our post here and east of the Alliance outpost of Silverwing.  Find and slay the outrunners, then return to me.

objectives.text: Kill 9 Ashenvale Outrunners, then return to Kuray'bin at Splintertree Outpost.

accept.text: I just picked up this shredder from Ratchet and I was on my way back to the Warsong Lumber Camp, where I am supposed to be on duty. I was given a manual on how to operate the shredder, but on the trip back, a huge gust of wind blew it from my hands. The pages went everywhere, and all I was left with was the cover.$B$BThe pages could be just about anywhere by now, I suppose... but I don't know how to use the shredder without them! Will you find them for me?

complete.text: Reading isn't my strong point... but now I'll be able to get back to work! Thanks, $N!

objectives.text: Find the 12 missing pages of the Shredder Operating Manual, and put them together to form Chapters 1, 2, and 3. Return the pages to Gurda Ragescar near Splintertree Post.

accept.text: Malcin claims he is outside Razorfen Downs. This ambassador must be slain--his mission a failure in the eyes of the Lich King.$B$BHis presence there does explain much of what we've discovered about the area--some of the quilboar have grown frightfully powerful while showing signs of the Plague in their own way. Truly that must be a sign of some sort of deal they've struck.$B$BFind Malcin and slay him, $n. Return to me after the deed is done.

objectives.text: Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Varimathras in the Undercity.

complete.text:
I recognize the insignia on this scroll, $N. You found this on that crone who reigns over Razorfen Kraul? Interesting.

The Scourge aren't content with one continent it seems. This Ambassador Malcin--the one who wrote the note--is one of the Scourge's plagued servants, a human diplomat to the kingdom of Lordaeron before things... changed.

If the Scourge are trying to gain a foothold in Kalimdor, then it is up to us to act.

progress.text: What business is it you wish to speak of, $N? You must feel it is important if you continue to pester me.

accept.text: Thank you for rescuing me! We must leave quickly before they discover that I am free. Please escort me to Camp Aparaje. From there, I know my way.$b$bMy father, Makaba Flathoof, will be desperate to know that I am safe.

complete.text: Kaya is alive! $N, I have you to thank for rescuing her.

objectives.text: Escort Kaya Flathoof to Camp Aparaje, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

complete.text: Ashenvale is a divided land, but our most recent efforts have been very successful. We not only have an outpost at the Zoram Strand, but another just north of here called Splintertree.
Take my update to Kadrak. Swiftly, $N.

progress.text:
Much danger lies along this path, $N. You'd do best to remember this while traveling in these lands. The threat of the alliance is quite near.

We are faced by enemies on all fronts. The satyr are a formidable and prevalent force in eastern Ashenvale.  I have also discovered that the naga have taken over a large area of the land of Azshara.

It's good to see that we are still bolstering our numbers -- be ready for what lies ahead, $N.

complete.text: Let Kadrak know of the success we have had here holding off the night elves. Our plans are going well.

progress.text:
Keep an eye out, skyborne. The elves are often hiding in the shadows...

We must always be watching. We have worked very hard to claim this land, and the elves are looking for a chance to take it from us.

I assume you have my next orders from Kadrak?

complete.text: $N, I thank you... but I will never forget what the Grimtotem have done to my village.

accept.text: Strength has left me. Your help is needed!$b$bLong ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well.$b$bAku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.$b$bThe Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.$b$bSlay Kelris and bring his head to Bashana in Thunder Bluff, $n, please.

objectives.text: Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

complete.text: Tsunaman sent you? Excellent. Then we have matters to discuss.

accept.text: Within the beginning tunnels of Blackfathom Deeps, large sapphire clusters can be found along the cave walls. Recently it was noted that the naga were harvesting the crystals. Until it can be discerned why, I sense we should stop the naga from succeeding. The crystals have great elemental power and if used inappropriately, could make for a powerful arcane component.$B$BWill you help me, $n? Blackfathom Deeps can be found along Zoram Strand to the north of our outpost.

objectives.text: Bring 20 Sapphires of Aku'Mai to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

accept.text: Some poor handwriting is scrawled on the crumpled up note:$B$B"Yes, tell all the priestesses to bring the crystals to me. The water elemental spirits are strong within them and they will aid our aquamancers greatly in their own summonings.$B$BBy controlling the power within the crystals, we will appease Aku'Mai. One day we will have enough power to bring Aku'Mai back to us and the world will return to its greatest era! An era of rule by the Old Gods!"

complete.text:
This is interesting indeed. I am glad you have brought it to my attention.

Now we have a name for our troubles... Lorgus Jett.

objectives.text: Bring the Damp Note to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

progress.text: Yes, $N? What is it you need? There is still much I must learn about the crystals the naga are gathering.

accept.text: This Twilight's Hammer follower cannot be allowed to complete his plan. The Twilight's Hammer do not understand the spirits of nature. They believe in the Old Gods--creatures of chaos and destruction that were long ago defeated. This Lorgus cannot be allowed to succeed. You must stop him, $n. I cannot do it myself--I am too weak.$B$BGo into Blackfathom Deeps, find him, and kill him. Return to me here at Zoram'gar when it's done.

objectives.text: Kill Lorgus Jett in Blackfathom Deeps and then return to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

accept.text: We are in short supply of a few items at the Warsong lumber camp!$B$BPixel at Splintertree Post has our shipment of saw blades. It'll take a trip to Booty Bay to pick up a crate of axes from Wharfmaster Lozgil.$B$BOur shipment of oil and rope will be more difficult. The rope was pilfered by the Thistlefur and Foulweald furbolgs, and the satyrs intercepted the delivery of the oil and are now using it for detestable rituals in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian!$B$BCan you help me?

objectives.text: Collect the Warsong Supplies: Warsong Saw Blades, Logging Rope, Warsong Oil, and the Warsong Axe Shipment for Locke Okarr in Splintertree Post.

progress.text:
Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here.

..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!

What I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.

So, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?

accept.text: $n, you've done a fine job killing Grimtotem. If you dare, Grundig Darkcloud and his personal band of brutes is by far the worst of the lot. He was the one who led the brutal attack on my village.$b$bYou will find him in Grimtotem Post a bit further up the path to the west. Kill him, and I will be forever grateful.

complete.text: Grundig Darkcloud is dead! $N, I will always be grateful for what you've done here today.

objectives.text: Kill Grundig Darkcloud and 6 Grimtotem Brutes, and return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

accept.text: The Twilight's Hammer has moved into the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps.  Their presence can only serve to coerce the elements into working against us.  If left unchecked, this region will be theirs for good.$B$B$n, go into Blackfathom and find the ruin's fathom stone; it should be somewhere close in the water.  In it is a fathom core - a device that when properly read it will relate a history of all elemental activity.  If I have it, I and the Earthen Ring can maybe do something to stop them!

objectives.text: Bring the Fathom Core to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.

accept.text: The defeated water elemental has left behind a strange water globe.  You surmise that the object somehow fed the beast energy.  Inside the globe, a putrid-looking form of water sloshes about.  The globe itself seems impervious to any sort of physical force.$B$BIf anyone can make any sense of this item, it would be Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring.  He is located at the Horde's Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.

objectives.text: Bring the Strange Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.

accept.text: Who says that the undead don't know anything about cooking? Take my secret recipe for Turtle Bisque, for example. I've known folks that would come back from the dead just to enjoy a bowl! Heh, heh...$B$BSpeaking of which, I haven't been able to make any lately.  I used to head over to Lake Lordamere myself to hunt snapjaws, the nasty things, but I can't pull myself away from my work here.$B$BIf you bring me some Turtle Meat from the snapjaws and soothing spices, I'll show you how it's done!

objectives.text: Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat and some Soothing Spices to Christoph Jeffcoat in Tarren Mill.

accept.text: The drawing is composed of rough, broad, strokes and seems to depict a large bird of prey. Despite the simple composition, the artist clearly viewed this creature with fear and awe. An expert on big game could likely tell you more.

objectives.text: Bring the Primitive Drawing to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.

accept.text:
The campsite before you is a grisly scene. Judging by the remains, the victims were two humans and a dwarf. Markings on the bones indicate a savage attack, but the looted supplies tell you this wasn't done by an animal. The wounds don't match centaur weaponry either.

Perhaps an experienced scavenger of these lands would know what to make of this.

objectives.text: Find someone in Desolace who knows about the pillaged campsite.

complete.text: I can feel their corruption from here. The twisted elementals the quilboar are summoning should be drawn to the cleansing ritual.

progress.text: There are many who practice shamanism in this world. It is up to us to ensure that the land is protected from misuse.

accept.text: Here mon, a Squall-breakers Potion be what you need. Drink this to protect yourself against the elements of the storm, but remember it only goin' to last for a short while.$B$BNow go, return to your friends in need. There's nothing more I can do for you.

complete.text: Our wind riders have found something, but they have been unable to get close enough to assess the situation. Were you able to find anything that might help us?

objectives.text: Return to Rau Cliffrunner in Thousand Needles at Freewind Post.

accept.text:
Now that you have the twisted totems, we must wield them to summon forth the corrupted elementals the quilboar are calling upon. Defeat them to cleanse these lands and put an end to the Razormane's abominable ritual then report back to Rau Cliffrunner with your success.

You should begin your clensing at the steam pools to the west. That area is rich with each of the elements. But be careful, $n. The quilboar will not sit idly while you interrupt their plans.

complete.text: The rumbling ground fell silent and in my heart I knew you had saved us. You have our gratitude, $N. You do your Earthen Ring proud.

objectives.text: Use the Twisted Totems to put an end to the quilboar ritual.

progress.text: Have you any news of the storm?

accept.text: Our people cannot thank you enough, but I have no real use for this eye. I have heard of an old shaman in the Alterac mountains that has an eye for storm elemental magic. Perhaps he may be able to craft something for you.

complete.text:
Ah, this be a powerful artifact, friend! I haven't crafted with some'ting like this in a long time.

You take good care o' dis now, ya here? Looks like ya went through plenty to get it!

objectives.text: Deliver the Eye of the Tempest to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac Mountains.

progress.text:
Great battle with de elements, mm? Tings turned out how they was always meant to.

But since you here, what brings you to ol' Bath'rah?

complete.text:
Ah, you have brought sunstones that the harpies collect! The harpies love to gather objects that are shiny, but they do not know the true value of the stones. By capturing the dazzling light of the sun, these stones reflect its majesty and allow us to adorn our shrines and homes with tiny motes of light in its honor. The moon, too, illuminates them with its silver beauty at night.

These stones remind us of the connection we have to the lights of the skies.

progress.text: I have important matters to consider, $c. Be quick.

complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.

progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.

accept.text:
I wouldn't dare to question the effectiveness of Apothecary Renferrel's formulae, however I would be lying if I said that the potion made any noticeable difference.

Along the shore of Lake Lordamere are a swarm of murlocs, and of note, murlocs have eyes. I suspect the apothecary's willingness to try new things is suppressed by his recent obsession with hearts. Bring him a few.

If my choice is to inevitably die a second death or have Renferrel kill me for questioning his methods, I choose the latter.

complete.text:
The potion didn't work? Of course it didn't work. You brought me insufficient hearts. The recipe clearly calls for six. You brought three.

However, I confess I hadn't considered applications for murloc parts until now...

<Renferrel takes the eyes.>

I can afford to sacrifice a few of my own hearts to get your Deathstalker's strength back.

objectives.text: Gather 3 murloc eyes and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

progress.text: Oh. You're back?

accept.text:
Here is the new potion to aid in Quinn's recovery, made with love extracted from six whole hearts.

Now, please excuse me before your presence necessitates more paperwork.

complete.text:
<Quinn takes the potion and drinks it.>

Yes, I can feel it working. I will soon be able to travel.

You have done me a great favor, $N.

objectives.text: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.

progress.text: You return! I was beginning to come to terms with devolving into a ghoul.

accept.text:
The Alliance had an army of mages known as the Kirin Tor. While they were powerful, the demonic Burning Legion proved to be even more so. In one fell swoop, the arch demon Archimonde flattened their city like it was a child's plaything. Those who remained were reduced to merely dispossessed vagabonds.

That is, until they rebuilt Dalaran. And on the Dark Lady's very doorstep, no less!

While in their camps, search for something that can get us into the city unnoticed. I must know more.

complete.text:
A sewer key? Well, thankfully I am not the one who will be using this.

But we have work to do before it's safe to use this.

objectives.text: Acquire the Dalaran Sewer Key for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.

progress.text: What have you found? An ancient tome? A secret relic?

accept.text:
<The preparations for a hastily-assembled ritual are gathered unceremoniously on the altar. According to the scrap of note, everything has been gathered. All that's missing are the offering of blood and the Tortured Soul.

The undead around you look tortured enough. They may have what you seek.>

complete.text:
<The tortured soul lets out a foul energy in the presence of the offering stone.

It appears you are closer to fulfilling the ritual.>

objectives.text: Collect a Tortured Soul from the nearby undead in Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest.

progress.text: <The offering stone is ominously still.>

accept.text:
<The scrap of note is mostly illegible. What is still readable, however, are notes about preparations for an offering.

An offering stone is mentioned, as well as a ritual.

Perhaps you can find this offering stone nearby.>

complete.text:
<Strange implements and items litter the rough surface of the stone.

This is surely the offering stone that is mentioned in the note.>

objectives.text: Find the Offering Stone in Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest.

accept.text:
<All that's left now is the offering of blood.

The note scrap mentioned a 'willing sacrifice.'

An intense sense of dread washes over you.>

complete.text:
<The offering stone is inert now. It appears your ritual drained it of power. To what end, you do not know, but it is over now.

The rough stone cracks and crumbles, now devoid of purpose.

Something glitters from within the remnants...>

objectives.text: Use the Tortured Soul to give an offering of blood at the Offering Stone in Beren's Peril.

accept.text:
Taking away their pendants is just the first step. If the Kirin Tor really are shipping a steady supply of relics from Dalaran, we must stop them at the source.

Search the roads around Ambermill for Dalaran's wizards and watchers. Their presence has allowed free access across our borders for too long. If we can cull their numbers, that should put a stop to these pendants making it into Silverpine Forest in the first place.

complete.text:
Ever since the barrier went down around Dalaran, the Kirin Tor have maintained a death grip on the roads. They're paranoid about something, that much is certain.

For now, however, the why is irrelevant.

objectives.text: Slay $1oa Dalaran Wizards and $2oa Dalaran Watchers for Shadow Priest Allister in the Sepulcher.

accept.text:
The ancient Gurubashi of Stranglethorn Vale were da masters of dark blood magics. Rumors be they'd use pure truesilver idols to channel that bad bad voodoo.

Ol' Mazu'kon would love to get his hands on one of those idols... for academics ya see. How 'bout you gather some friends and do a bit of smash and grab on that drowned city stickin' out the ocean off the coast of Stranglethorn? Kill the most impressive lookin' priest ya can find in there, and they sure to have what I be lookin' for.

objectives.text: Recover an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City.

accept.text:
Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.

I care not for the fate of the mage city, $n, but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.

objectives.text: Defeat Atrexis the Grave Knight in the City of Dalaran for Melisara in Tarren Mill.

accept.text:
With the city of Dalaran under siege by their own constructs, this is the perfect opportunity to, let's say, borrow a few samples.

Imagine an army of arcane-powered abominations. The Dark Lady would have no choice but to recognize my alchemical prowess. Maybe even grant me head of the Royal Apothecary Society?

Go to the city and find the constructs' cores. They are unlikely to give them willingly, so do what you must.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Cracked Sentry Cores in the City of Dalaran for Doctor Martin Felben in Undercity.

accept.text:
You there, $c. I need your aid. There are rumors of a beast that makes its lair deep in a cave at Thorn Hill, northeast of here. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener". It's supposedly five times the size of a normal quilboar with a thirst for blood that can never be sated.

Most don't believe the tales. But I do--because I've fought its like before.

Seek out its lair and slay Chol'aruk. Bring me its head. I warn you though--prepare well and do not go alone.

Blood and thunder, $c.

complete.text:
Impressive, $c. None will doubt my tales when I return to Orgrimmar with this grim proof of the existence of these abominations. Rest assured this glory is yours however, and I will speak loudly of your deeds.

Lok-tar!

objectives.text: Bring the head of Chol'aruk to Gur'ak in the Barrens.

progress.text:
It took the strength of six skilled fighters to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to fell four of us before we could put it down.

If these monstrous beasts were to appear in greater numbers, the damage that the quilboar could inflict upon the land could be catastrophic.

complete.text:
Whooooa! Nice one, pal! You saved me from another one of Gagsprocket's unbearable lectures on the cost of metal. More importantly, I can jump right into building my next prototype.

Uhhh, I didn't have a reward planned... Do you like boxes?

progress.text: Not another word out of you until your pockets are jingling with metal!

accept.text:
Ever strike a deal with a satyr, mon?

I have. How could I resist? The promise of power, knowledge far exceeding what any ordinary tome could offer... all alongside an eager and charismatic minion. What more could I ask for?

Bah, of course they would never bend the knee to a mortal. I bargained when I had nothing, only to be cast aside with even less.

Now, I want revenge. Revenge against the Hatefury. Raid their camp to the northeast! Stain the dirt with their foul blood.

objectives.text: Defeat a variety of Hatefury satyr at Sargeron in Desolace and then return to Aka'rai in Shadowprey Village.

accept.text:
With an influx of new recruits like yourself, it's been hard to keep our weapons supplied. Our weaponsmith, Kzan, is running low on training weapons and I'd like to see what kinds of skills you possess to get an idea of what I have to work with. Luckily for you, I have a solution to both.

While you're out there cutting your teeth on boars, salvage six abandoned training weapons. Our failed recruits left them laying on the ground. Once you do, return them to our weaponsmith Kzan behind me in the Den.

complete.text: Thank you for returning these weapons, $N. I will get to work repairing them for the next wave of recruits.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Abandoned Training Weapons, then return to Kzan Thornslash in the Den.

progress.text:
Throm'ka, $c. Gorak told me I should be expecting you. It is good to see you in one piece!

Were you able to collect the training weapons I requested?

accept.text:
Blessings of An'she, friend.

We tauren have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds and I was hoping you'd be interested in honoring this tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.

complete.text:
You have done well.

I thank you for taking the time to perform one of our time-honored traditions, skyborne. I hope that as you travel you will find plenty of occasions you wish to give thanks for.

Should you ever wish to perform the ritual again, you should be able to repurchase the components I sent you to collect.

Go with An'she's warmth.

objectives.text:
Purchase a Bundle of Herbs from Nida the herbalist, a Bundle of Cedar Twigs from Nata the enchanting supplier, and Sinew Thread from Mahu the leatherworking supplier and Ceremonial Flint and Tinder from Naal the cooking supplier.

Combine the items and sprinkle the incense off of Hunter's Rise.

progress.text:
There are many occasions one may choose to spread incense to the winds. You could be asking the Earthmother to watch over someone, bless a hunt, celebrate an occasion, or even to seek guidance from our ancestors.

Or it could be something else entirely.

Though the act is done with reverence, it is not strictly a ceremonial affair. Typically there are certain traditional steps observed when performing this act, but many tribes have differing practices.

accept.text:
Greetings, friend. I wonder if I may ask a favor of you? I have just run out of red pigment for my paints, and I am looking for one with younger hooves to make the long journey into the Stonetalon Mountains on my behalf.

In the middle of the mountain pass there lies a large circular lake, Mirkfallon Lake, that has a unique plant that grows within its waters. The pods of this plant, mirkweed, turn a vibrant red when dried. Gather the pods of this plant for me, and I will reward you well for your efforts.

objectives.text: Tah Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff wants $1oa Mirkweed Pods from Mirkfallon Lake.

progress.text:
You have returned! Were you able to find the mirkweed plant pods in Mirkfallon Lake?

We tauren have used this plant pigment in our paints for generations, so any amount you manage to bring would be appreciated. Though there are many ways to get a red pigment, I find the mirkweed to give the richest and most vibrant hue of the methods I'm familiar with.

accept.text:
You! Quickly, I need you to bring this potion across the slime canal to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium!

It has a very limited shelf life, and no I can't go myself, my knees rattle and pop out if I attempt to run.

Just another lovely side effect of undeath, apparently.

But we're wasting time! Here, take this and go!

<Alessandro makes a shooing motion.>

complete.text:
Ah, marvelous! I had been waiting for Alessandro's potion to arrive. The last six he sent destabilized along the way, but you've made it just in time!

Here, take this for your effort. That is all for now, unless you have other business with me?

If not, remove yourself so I may continue my experiments unhindered.

objectives.text: Bring the Unstable Potion to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium within the time limit.

accept.text:
Fascinating, aren't they? This is the first time I have ever been privy to the secrets of abomination creation.

I have been studying these notes, and it appears we need a heart. A massive one!

I hear there is a thunder lizard there of impressive size called Stormheart, that patrols along the canyon edge in Thousand Needles. With a name like that it must have the perfect heart. I must have that heart!

Oh, also I suggest you bring friends. Stormheart isn't known for being docile.

objectives.text: Slay Stormheart in Thousand Needles and acquire its heart.

accept.text:
<A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Return damaged shipments or empty crates to the Durotar Supply and Logistics trade outpost, now conveniently located due west of the Crossroads in the Barrens. Your time is valuable and we will compensate you for your efforts!"

Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>

complete.text:
You found the right place, and you're speaking with the right person! I can jot you down as one of our new associates. No paperwork necessary on your part, I can't be bothered with more of that.

All we ask of you is to assist in dealing with compromised deliveries you find during your travels. Doing so will earn you Merchant's Favor, which you can use to purchase goods and services right here. Here's a bit to get you settled in!

Do you happen to have the crate this label came with?

objectives.text: Deliver the Shipping Label to someone at the Durotar Supply and Logistics trade hub near the Crossroads in the Barrens.

progress.text: Good day, traveler. How can I assist?

accept.text:
Gaaah!

I'm so angry. They said Ashenvale was easy to follow. Easy for who? The beasts? The birds?

One moment I was gathering an herb, the next I'm trapped in this ravine. Do I truly have to circle half the forest to reach where I stood just moments ago?

When I'm like this, my spells grow volatile and behave... differently.

Could you thin the wildlife nearby? Even their stupid hooves grate on me. I despise this cursed forest.

objectives.text: Kill $1oa Shadowhorn Stag and $2oa Ashenvale Bear and return to Va'xug Firefure northwest of Fallen Sky Lake.

accept.text:
Ah, it's all become so embarrassingly clear! Arugal hardly had any magic at all, let alone enough to create the worgen. 'Arugal's Curse.' Pah! Barely potent enough to last a few seconds.

These shackles prove he can bind the beasts, not create them. The worgen clearly spread their curse a different way. I would know how.

Go to the Greymane Wall to the south. The worgen seem to be spreading to the humans nearby. Tear the beasts apart and bring me whatever you find. This requires a more direct approach.

complete.text:
It appears I get the last laugh after all, haha! Arugal truly was a fool. And I, Dalar Dawnweaver, have exposed him as the fraud he is.

These pieces are all the proof I need that the curse has nothing to do with that blithering dolt.

Regrettably, that means his remedy is also worth nothing. It seems the search for a solution to the worgen curse continues.

objectives.text: Bring $1oa Worgen Bits to Dalar Dawnweaver in The Sepulcher.

progress.text: Fangs, claws, gizzards. It makes no difference to me. The easiest way to study something is to see the guts yourself.

accept.text:
If there is one thing we do know, it is that Arugal is responsible for worgen within Silverpine--be it his own machinations or otherwise. What we don't know is how it spreads.

While I research a way to stop the curse, our first priority is to contain it. It appears this affliction cannot infect forsaken, but a large group of humans have gathered by the Greymane Wall.

Go to the wall and put down these refugees before they have a chance to become servants for Arugal. And try not to get bit, skyborne.

objectives.text: Slay $1oa Sickly Refugees and $2oa Haggard Refugees for Dalar Dawnweaver in The Sepulcher.

accept.text: The Theramore Expeditionary Force are tenacious and continue to send reinforcements to bolster their position on the Darkspear Islands. $B$BGo, show them the might of the Horde! Bring me the evidence of your victory in this key battleground and you will be well rewarded.

objectives.text: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
